introduction: Kern County DHS administers CalFresh food assistance. BenefitsCal is the current online application route recommended by California CDSS.
description: Kern County DHS administers CalFresh food assistance. BenefitsCal is the current online application route recommended by California CDSS.

sections.who: DHS assesses household circumstances under current CalFresh rules. Income, eligible expenses and applicable student or status conditions affect the decision.
sections.get: Approved food benefits are issued through EBT. The county determines the amount.
sections.docs:
• Household identity and income records.
  • Relevant expense and other verification requested by DHS.
sections.apply:
1. Apply

    Start at BenefitsCal or contact Kern DHS for another intake route.

  2. Complete the interview

    Explain the household circumstances and any urgent lack of food.

  3. Provide verification

    Follow county document requests and keep submission evidence.
sections.after: Read the decision, reporting duties and recertification deadline. Ask DHS about expedited service if the household has an immediate food emergency.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using Kern CalFresh; CDSS portal transition; County application rights. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Is GetCalFresh the current application portal?
CDSS directs applications to BenefitsCal; GetCalFresh provides information and support.
Yes. The county handles the case.
What if food is needed urgently?
Request expedited-service screening and contact local food resources.
